questions.answer_excerpt:
**PricingSvc incident, 2026-08-14 (SEV1, INC-0814).** An expired vendor TLS certificate on the MarketDataFeed connection left PricingSvc serving stale cached prices from 09:31 ET. Live ticks resumed at 16:55. Seven downstream systems were affected, directly or indirectly.

**What happened** (postmortem [doc-00019])
- **Cause:** The certificate was installed by hand in 2025. It was in no inventory or renewal calendar, so nobody owned its renewal. The feed handler only logged WARN on handshake failures, so no alert fired.
- **Silent failure:** PricingSvc stayed "up" and served its last-good cach
